scenes.headline: How ZDTaichu re-thinks the tokens it is unsure of
scenes.sub: A Qwen decoder, a RADIO vision tower, and an entropy gate.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cherry! ZDTaichu is an open vision-language model for spatial reasoning. Its headline trick spends extra compute on the tokens it's unsure about. Here's how.

scenes.label: The headline trick
scenes.text: When the next token looks uncertain, run four middle layers once more, and keep the new answer only if the model grows surer.
scenes.mark: only if the model grows surer
scenes.say: The idea: when the next token looks uncertain, run four middle layers once more, and keep the new answer only if the model grows surer.

scenes.title: One extra pass, for uncertain tokens only

steps.say: ZDTaichu is a Qwen3.5 decoder, thirty-two layers deep, with NVIDIA's C-RADIOv4-H vision tower bolted on. Every token first takes one ordinary pass.
The gate measures the entropy of the next-token distribution. Under the threshold, the token goes out as normal.

steps.note: hybrid KV and DeltaNet cache: forked and snapshotted
steps.say: Over it, layers twelve to fifteen run again, on a damped blend of their own input and output.
The new logits are kept only if entropy went down. At the defaults, that's one extra pass over four of thirty-two layers.

scenes.title: Where the damping comes from
scenes.say: The blend isn't a tuned constant. It comes straight from the iteration limit.

parts.note: extra passes allowed; the shipped default is 1
parts.say: Max iters defaults to one, so the damping is a half: a flat fifty-fifty average.
Raise it to three, and each pass moves the hidden state only a quarter of the way.

scenes.title: MMSI-Bench: one model, three settings
scenes.note: Format prompt: 104 of 1,000 questions. Entropy gate: 6.
scenes.say: On MMSI-Bench the model card says forty-seven point two, with a think-and-box format instruction. The lab's own ungated run says thirty-six point eight. The gate adds six questions.

scenes.text: Extra depth for uncertain tokens is cheap, but entropy measures confidence, not accuracy: a surer wrong answer still passes.

recap: A RADIO vision tower feeds a Qwen3.5-9B decoder
The rerun is kept only if entropy drops
scenes.say: To recap: a Qwen decoder with a RADIO eye, and a gate that re-runs four layers when it's unsure.
